subject: Request: Sandbox top-up & short trial extension due to connector certification hold
messages:
From: Ethan Blair <ethan.blair@ledgerworks.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@ledgerworks.com>, support@ledgerworks.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 17:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access for PoC / connector certification snag

Hi Naomi,

Quick update from our side: our security team paused the self-hosted adapter certification yesterday after the first round of tests flagged an I/O permission mismatch when the connector writes to the log path. That blocks our integration engineers from finishing end-to-end validation.

We still plan to go live with the PoC — just need two weeks to clear the cert queue and run one more compliance scan. The current sandbox credits are nearly exhausted and our devs are blocked without extra tokens/space. Can Redwood provide a short sandbox top-up (tokens + one-off extension) so we can keep testing while we sort certs?

If possible we’d like:
- 2 weeks trial extension (or until 2027-06-14)
- temporary sandbox top-up (~30k tokens + increased ephemeral storage)

This is a time-sensitive ask; our execs want the demo to Redwood on 6/20.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Blair
Head of Integrations, LedgerWorks
ethan.blair@ledgerworks.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Blair <ethan.blair@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access for PoC / connector certification snag

Hi Ethan — thanks for the update and for outlining the ask. Sorry to hear the certification hit a snag; totally understandable that your team needs runway.

I’m looping in Marissa (owner for commercial terms) and Ben (sales lead) to see what we can do quickly. Diego, tagging you for an engineering read on the error archive Ethan mentioned — if there’s a short mitigation (e.g., alternate log path config) we can suggest to unblock devs sooner.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ethan Blair <ethan.blair@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@ledgerworks.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 20:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access for PoC / connector certification snag

On Fri, May 28, 2027 at 6:02 PM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Naomi: Diego, tagging you for an engineering read on the error archive Ethan mentioned — if there’s a short mitigation (e.g., alternate log path config) we can suggest to unblock devs sooner.

Thanks Naomi — Ethan/Rajiv, I pulled the errlog you attached to the support ticket (adapter-errlog-20270527.zip). The I/O permission mismatch looks like our client writes to /var/log/redwood/ by default; if your cert environment is locked down we can provide a build with a configurable log path env var that writes to /tmp/ during the scan. That change is trivial and I can ship a patched binary by Monday 05/31 if you can run the scan again.

If you’d rather not take a custom build, there’s a documented workaround in the cert checklist (see connector-cert-checklist.pdf) to create an allowed log mount. ETA for our patched build: 05/31 11:00 PDT.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Principal Engineer, Runtime Integrations | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access for PoC / connector certification snag

Naomi / Ben — per Ethan’s ask and Diego’s mitigation plan: LedgerWorks will likely need the additional tokens for ~2 weeks while they run the cert scan again. Their demo is important for closing the enterprise contract (DW-3472).

I recommend we approve:
- 30k token sandbox top-up (one-time)
- 21-day trial extension (until 2027-06-18)

Ben — can you approve a one-off top-up and note any promo/discount that should apply? If approved I’ll prepare a short approval note we can log in HubSpot and attach to the account.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox access for PoC / connector certification snag

Approved.

Notes:
- Grant 30k token top-up to LedgerWorks sandbox immediately.
- Trial extension: 21 days (new end date 2027-06-18).
- No additional discount on committed pricing for now; if they sign enterprise contract before 07/15 we can offer a one-time onboarding credit.

Marissa — please create the HubSpot line item and attach "sandbox-topup-approval-note.txt" to the deal. Naomi — can you confirm with Ethan once the build is pushed (Diego) and the top-up is applied?

Ben Carter
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

--
attachments referenced: connector-cert-checklist.pdf (see drive), adapter-errlog-20270527.zip (support ticket).
